# OpenState — full reference

> GENERATED — do not hand-edit. Regenerate with `node tools/build-llms-txt.mjs`.
> Reference for OpenState 0.1.0 (0.x series). Tool names/counts parsed from src/mcp/src/index.ts; pricing parsed from website/pricing.html.

Local project state and structural code tools for coding agents: 36 tools (22 structural code calls = 8 readers + 7 preview/apply pairs; 14 state and lifecycle tools). Free to try (30 structural applies per machine), then $10 a month or $129 once for every 0.x release. All sales are final. The engine stays on the machine.

## Pricing (parsed from pricing.html)

- $10 a month, or $129 once for every 0.x release; one developer, on up to 3 machines.
- Free: the whole product including 30 structural applies per machine; searches, reads and previews are never limited.
- Checkout is hosted by Stripe; all sales are final.
- Monthly checkout: https://openstate-license.michaelallenkuykendall.workers.dev/buy?tier=monthly
- Lifetime checkout: https://openstate-license.michaelallenkuykendall.workers.dev/buy?tier=lifetime
